title: Gem bid for Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Branded All-in-one PC, Multi Function Printers, UPS, Pen drive, Microsoft Office and Anti Virus software
summary: GeM bid by the Goa Directorate for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of all-in-one PCs, multifunction printers, UPS units, antivirus, MS Office 365 licences and pen drives at Deep Bhavan, Bambolim.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, Near GMC Stadium, Bambolim, North Goa
sites.work: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of IT hardware and software

scope.item: Branded all in one computers with warranty 5 years
Branded Multifunction Color laserjet printer with warranty 5 years
Branded Multifunction laserjet printer with warranty 5 years
Antivirus 10 user pack with validity 3 years
MS Office 365 suite software with certified license government edition 2022 version
Pen drive with 64GB capacity and 1 year warranty

money.notes: Estimated bid value per GeM. EMD exemption per GeM GTC for eligible MSE manufacturers/startups. Advisory bank State Bank of India; beneficiary Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships Goa. MII and MSE purchase preference apply.

period.warranty: 5 years for all-in-one PCs and printers; pen drives 1 year; antivirus validity 3 years (as per item titles)

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 50 lakh
OEM average turnover (last 3 years): Rs 100 lakh
3 years past experience supplying same/similar products to Govt/PSU/listed company; MSE and startup exemption for experience and turnover
Past performance: supplied 80% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years
ISO 9001 certification of bidder or OEM; OEM authorisation; malicious code certificate; dedicated/toll-free service number and escalation matrix
Installation by OEM/OEM certified resource or authorised reseller; products with at least 5 years residual market life; compatibility with existing hardware and software
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers (min 50% / 20% local content)
Two packet bid; total value wise evaluation; no reverse auction
specs: Detailed specifications and BOQ are in separate GeM attachments (Specification Document / BOQ Detail Document), not included in this file
Faulty hard disks not returned to OEM under warranty
notes: GeM bid dated 07-02-2024, end 19-02-2024 18:00, opening 19-02-2024 18:30, pre-bid 12-02-2024 15:00 at Deep Bhavan, Bambolim. BOQ title 'SITC of All in One PC with Printers software and accessories'; total quantity 61. Standard GeM clauses otherwise. Consignee officer personal name omitted.
